items.name: J MacArthur
items.quote:
The impact Jamah has had on our children, our curriculum, and our community is positive and considerable.

He understands that children have different starting points and individual needs. Children feel included and are engaged as a result. Jamah successfully adapts lessons and his teaching to meet the needs of children with SEND. The take up for after school clubs is significant — we are oversubscribed with a waiting list.

items.name: S Cooke
items.quote:
Jamah's transition into the school, working with groups and individual complex learners, was seamless. He immediately built a connection with pupils and staff alike.

Through drumming, steel pans, percussion, rap and poetry sessions he has allowed our pupils to explore their creativity, develop improved skills, self-confidence and discipline. Jamah has had a genuine positive impact on the lives of our learners, with pupils keen to see him each week.

items.name: C Husbands
items.quote:
Jamah brings a calm and empathetic presence that has a positive impact on the young people he supports.

Jamah has shown particular strength in building trusting relationships with children and young people who may have experienced significant trauma or instability. His time at Brighter Steps has been marked by dedication, resilience, and a genuine passion for making a difference in the lives of vulnerable young people.

items.name: M Genis
items.quote:
Jamah has performed at high-profile events including live broadcasts on BBC and ITV, WOMAD Festival, and the iconic Notting Hill Carnival.

His unique approach blends music, sport, and animal welfare to positively influence young people, particularly those with special educational needs. He brings not only skill and professionalism but also heart and purpose to everything he does.

items.name: Anna
items.role: Head of Performing Arts, The Castle School, Newbury
items.quote:
Jamah has a natural warmth, energy and authenticity that enables him to connect with every student, regardless of their individual needs or abilities. He quickly earns their trust and respect, creating an environment where pupils feel safe to take risks, challenge themselves and succeed.

Jamah is one of the most inspiring visiting practitioners we have worked with. His passion for young people, belief in their potential and ability to bring out the very best in them leaves a lasting impact that extends far beyond music.

items.name: G Gibbons
items.role: Film Producer, Online Safety Project (Thames Valley Police)
items.quote: Congrats Jamah! You are filling a huge gap in our school system. If only every school in the UK had you.

items.name: Sian
items.quote:
He connects brilliantly with kids, even on days where they are tired or just not having the best day, Jamah manages to bring the best out of them.

Jamah makes something that looks like it should be chaos feel calm, structured and most importantly fun.

items.name: Bibi (Hannah)
items.quote:
Your dedication goes far beyond simply teaching music. Through your passion, patience, and encouragement, you create a supportive and inspiring environment where young people can learn, build confidence, and express themselves.

The discipline, focus, teamwork, and self-belief you help develop will stay with them well beyond their lessons.

items.name: Rob and Jo
items.quote:
We spent too long not seeing a smile on his face on Mondays. We love seeing the smile return!

We know you will be one of the influences in his life who we won't forget.

items.name: Music programme partner
items.quote: Through your passion, patience, and encouragement, you create a supportive and inspiring environment where young people can learn, build confidence and express themselves.
